user.title: Connect to Anode
user.description: Sign in with the email for your Anode account and an API key. Create a key in the Anode web app under Settings → API.

data_description.email: The email address you sign in to the Anode web app with.
data_description.api_key: An API key created in the Anode web app.

hub.title: Choose a hub
hub.description: This account has no hub of its own, for example an installer account. Enter the ID of the hub to add. It is printed on the hub's label.

data_description.hub_id: The short friendly ID, for example ehxbt.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Anode
reauth_confirm.description: Anode no longer accepts the API key for hub {hub_id}. Enter a new key.

reconfigure.title: Update Anode credentials
reconfigure.description: Change the account email or API key used for hub {hub_id}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Anode cloud. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Anode did not accept that email and API key.
error.hub_not_found: This account cannot access that hub. Check the hub ID.
error.hub_offline: The hub did not respond. Check that it is powered on and connected, then try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This hub is already set up.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to read from the Anode cloud. Every read is relayed to the hub over the internet.

auth_failed.message: Anode rejected the API key. Re-authenticate the integration to continue.

hub_offline.message: Hub {hub_id} did not respond. Check that it is powered on and connected.

hub_offline_command.message: The hub did not respond, so the change was not applied. Check that it is powered on and connected, then try again.

command_failed.message: The hub did not apply the change: {error}

invalid_soc_window.message: Minimum state of charge ({min_soc}%) cannot be higher than maximum ({max_soc}%).

soc_limits_unavailable.message: The hub did not report state-of-charge limits for battery {battery_id}, so they cannot be changed.

hub_not_found.message: {target} is not an Anode hub or one of its devices.

hub_not_loaded.message: Anode hub {hub_id} is not loaded. Check the integration in Settings → Devices & services.

retired_entities.title: Anode override selects were replaced

set_override.name: Set override
set_override.description: Runs the hub in a mode for a set time, ignoring its schedule.

device_id.name: Hub
device_id.description: The Anode hub, or any battery or meter paired to it.

hub_id.name: Hub ID
hub_id.description: Friendly ID of the hub. Deprecated: choose the hub under Hub instead.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to override the schedule for, in seconds. 0 ends any active override.

cancel_override.name: Cancel override
cancel_override.description: Ends any active override so the hub follows its schedule again.
